# Keshav Markan

> Portfolio of Keshav Kumar Markan, a Bachelor of Computer Science student at Conestoga College working in software engineering, applied AI research, and accessible learning resources.

The normal portfolio contains readable experience and project information. An optional interactive 3D campus presents the same work. Camera hand scrolling is optional; essential content is available without camera access or solving puzzles.

## Portfolio

- [Work experience](https://keshavmarkan.com/#folio-experience-section): Research Assistant, Deepiri Software Engineer Intern, PAL Student Leader, OER Assistant, and CSI Student Life Representative. PAL facilitates collaborative learning. OER work develops accessible, zero-cost learning resources.
- [Selected projects](https://keshavmarkan.com/#folio-selected): Software Effort Estimator, ChainBreak Lab, and Naftelia.
- [100 Days, 100 Projects](https://keshavmarkan.com/#folio-series): Day 1 is Smart Traffic Navigator using Dijkstra's algorithm. Day 2 is this portfolio. Day 3 is Ki Forge, a local Python/OpenCV/MediaPipe hand-gesture energy particle playground. The calendar day and published project count are separate; future projects are not published automatically.
- [Community](https://keshavmarkan.com/#folio-leadership): GDG Conestoga Executive Lead and GDG Waterloo Subcommittee Member.
- [Contact and education](https://keshavmarkan.com/#folio-about): Bachelor of Computer Science, expected 2029. Contact marrkann08@gmail.com.
